protocol.objective: Directional information, NOT executable trade/PnL optimization
protocol.prior_results: Phase2 REJECT; v0.1 INCONCLUSIVE; Phase4 INCONCLUSIVE; immutable
protocol.math: Unchanged PR23 KONKORDE_PROXY, AO5/34 HL2, ADX/DI14, BBWP CLOSE/SMA7/prior100
protocol.ao: Sign context; sustained momentum requires two consecutive same-sign slopes OR confirmed zero cross. Single histogram color alone is insufficient. Acceleration and toward/away zero descriptive.
protocol.tf_bias: AO_ONLY: sign. AO_DI: UP when AO>0 and+DI>-DI; DOWN when AO<0 and-DI>+DI; TRANSITION when nonzero AO and DI disagree, NEUTRAL on ties, UNKNOWN on unavailable required data. ADX never assigns direction.
protocol.hierarchy: 1D macro,4H swing,1H timing; never three equal votes. Macro/swing aligned =>UP/DOWN, opposite1H impulse is PULLBACK. Opposite4H plus1H agreeing with4H=>TRANSITION with explicit lean; opposite4H and1H agreeing withmacro=>CONFLICT. Partial transitions=>TRANSITION only with a timing lean, otherwise UNCLEAR. Missing macro/swing=>UNCLEAR.
protocol.timing: Sustained AO momentum/zero cross with matching DI=>impulse_up/down; mixed momentum/DI=>transition; otherwise no_impulse. Aligned macro/swing and opposite impulse=>pullback, retaining pullback direction.
protocol.strength: STRONG: aligned macro/swing plus ADX rising and BBWP rising on BOTH1D/4H. BUILDING: candidate direction and4H ADX+BBWP rising OR aligned1H impulse with1H ADXturn+BBWP rising. Otherwise WEAK. No ADX magnitude threshold, points, fitted score or volatility zones.
protocol.grade: A: UP/DOWN, alignedmacro/swing,STRONG,no missing/opposite4H ML confirmation; B: UP/DOWN otherwise; C:TRANSITION/UNCLEAR/CONFLICT or known opposite ML. Visual coherence grade, not statistical proof/probability/sizing.1D ML is unavailable in existing observer.
protocol.mlrsi: READ ONLY confirmed cache from unchanged LOW29/EMA4 PINE_PARITY_V4 BinanceSPOT observer. No imports/math/threshold recomputation; provisional/approaching ignored. Known opposite4H confirmed ML=>CONFLICT; missing ML never fabricated neutral. Historical ML ablation PENDING without actual recorded confirmed states.1D unsupported, UNKNOWN.
protocol.konkorde: Inside geometry unchangedPR23. Positive ENTRY/inside,EXIT,quickREENTRY<=3TFbars, negative/fallingoutside bearish PROXY context. EXIT never automaticallySHORT. Distance/separation continuous, no zero proximity entry threshold.
protocol.levels: READ ONLY ManualCopilot confirmed_structure2L/2R; bounded220TFbars matching existing market history scale. 1H/4H/1D pivots available only at confirmation close; independent scales frozen until nextTFclose. PreviousUTCday/week(Monday) highs/lows from complete periods. Nearest S/R across confirmed levels; crossed4H/1D levels remain original type awaiting thatTFclose. No distance optimization.
protocol.structure_conflict: UP/DOWN=>CONFLICT only if latest closed1H range touches an opposing4H/1D pivot already known at previous1H close and closes back on original side; no intrabar/live mark authority. AT_SUPPORT/AT_RESISTANCE are actual range-touch labels, otherwise BETWEEN_LEVELS; OPEN_SPACE_UP/DOWN not claimed when no finite set proves absence of farther levels.
protocol.episodes: One continuous finalstate=one episode regardless strength/detail changes; newevent only on state change. No synthetic split-start event; missing-data state breaks episode. Separate TF AO_DI andAO_ONLY episodes; transitions retain lean separately, unclear has no direction.

outcomes.reference: Known closed reference; future PUBLIC1H closed bars only. No fill/fees/PnL model or trading claim.
outcomes.barriers: Directional favorable/adverse2/5/10%; SHORT1-price/ref. Same1Hbar touchingboth=>AMBIGUOUS, never favorable victory. Adverse-before-target bounded by prior bars and inclusive targetbar, no invented intrabar order.
outcomes.censoring: Split-end/gap/unmature stays incomplete. No interpolation or counting pending as loss.
outcomes.false_reversal: Directional episode preceded by opposite last directional episode and then reverting within configured3TFbars(MTF24h); evaluative future labels only, censored at right edge.

protocol.controls: Up to3 deterministic non-episode-start timestamps matching UTCyear/month/hour, lastclosed4H SMA200 regime and volatility quartile; TRAIN ATR1H/price cutpoints for TEST. Samehorizon maturity in same split; no return-based choice; require at least1. For nondirectional states report rawBTC descriptive only, not signed directional accuracy.
protocol.bootstrap: Weekly calendar blocks1000 seed8192 of paired excess; overlapping outcomes not independent. No multiplicity-corrected significance claim.
protocol.walk_forward: 2022..2026 fixed rules, no selection/refit; matching volatility cutpoints fitted only through prior year. Do not pick a family or alter parameters with TEST.
protocol.ablation: AO_ONLY hierarchy; AO_DI hierarchy; conditional same AO_DI episodes with4H ADXrising, then BBWPrising, then directionalKcontext; then confirmedMLaligned if real input available; structure adds opposing-level test context on public hierarchy. Conditional subsamples not new strategies; no-op/identical masks reported, not independent replications.
protocol.noise: Historical engine/V8 onsets only: nearest one-to-one UPevent match within24h, signed latency engine minusV8; overlap +hourlystate agreement/transitionrate. V8FLAT is NOT DOWN. Other actualforward overlap/false anticipation PENDING without journals.

NO DIRECTIONAL VALUE if both directions >=50 and nonpositiveTESTmean/excess; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE DIRECTION ENGINE. No trading profitability or authorization conclusion.
